text.offer: Of course you'll need an instrument to play. I'll even help you get one. Here's what you do: Lady Aftyn, the healer in Marion, can set you up with one. Go to her and tell her Parrin sent you.
text.complete: Thank you, here is the lute. Please learn to play it well.

steps.objective: Tell Lady Aftyn that Parrin sent you

steps.brief: You are going to learn to play from Parrin?! Good luck! By the way, Parrin owes me a favor. If you do something for me, I'll give you the lute: I need this rushed to Afiera D'xor in Jasper. When you've done that, come back.

steps.objective: Collect the lute from Lady Aftyn
steps.brief: Ah, I've been anxiously awaiting this! Thank you for your swift delivery. Go back to Lady Aftyn for your lute.
